edges.fact: The user is planning a trip to Miami and considering flying with American Airlines.
The user flew with American Airlines from New York on February 20th and had a terrible experience with the in-flight entertainment system.
The user flew with American Airlines to Los Angeles on February 20th and had a terrible experience with the in-flight entertainment system.
American Airlines' Boeing 737-800 aircraft feature seat-back screens with a touchscreen interface offering movies, TV shows, music, games, and live TV.
American Airlines' Boeing 777-200 aircraft feature seat-back screens with a touchscreen interface offering movies, TV shows, music, games, and live TV.
American Airlines' Airbus A321T aircraft feature seat-back screens with a touchscreen interface offering movies, TV shows, music, games, and live TV.
American Airlines provides tablet-based entertainment pre-loaded with movies, TV shows, and games on its Boeing 737 MAX aircraft.
American Airlines provides tablet-based entertainment pre-loaded with movies, TV shows, and games on its Airbus A321 aircraft.

American Airlines offers the American Airlines app, which lets passengers stream personal-device entertainment on select aircraft, receive flight update notifications, check in, and access a mobile boarding pass.
American Airlines is active on Twitter under the handle @AmericanAir, where customers can reach out for assistance or report issues.
American Airlines is active on Facebook, where customers can reach out for assistance or report issues.
American Airlines has a customer service rating of 3/5 stars on Skytrax, based on over 22,000 reviews.
American Airlines has a customer service rating of 3.5/5 stars on TripAdvisor, based on over 33,000 reviews.
American Airlines has a customer service rating of 64/100 from Consumer Reports, based on a survey of over 18,000 passengers.
American Airlines offers trip insurance through its partner, Allianz Global Assistance, covering trip cancellations, interruptions, delays, and baggage loss or damage.

American Airlines' Baggage Delivery Guarantee promises delivery of a delayed bag within 24 hours (a $25 voucher for future travel if it fails to do so) and reimbursement of up to $3,500 for a lost bag.
American Airlines' Baggage Protection is a separate insurance policy covering checked bags up to $1,000 per bag, with a premium of about $12-$20 per person per trip.
